question: Which of the following animals are endemic to Australia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kangaroo**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kangaroo** is an animal that is endemic to Australia.
 
• Endemic species are those that are found in a specific geographical area and nowhere else in the world.
 
• The **Kangaroo** is a marsupial from the family Macropodidae (macropods, meaning "large foot").
